purpose: Specify the fail-closed, pre-implementation boundary for a future NB-8 distributed operation and scale capability. It creates no worker, queue, lease, failover, reconciliation, restore, cross-Area sharing, protected-state writer, runtime authorization, or release claim.
hard_predecessors: accepted ADR-018-conformant Goal and Action Gate decisions
NB-5 serial action-control, independent verification, indeterminate-effect, and reconciliation evidence

authority_boundary.distributed_component_role: A future worker, queue, lease manager, failover process, reconciler, backup process, or cross-Area adapter may transport or verify a gate-authorized request only. It cannot create authority, grant approval, alter scope, commit protected state, declare an effect or goal successful, or replace an owning Gate.

immutable_scope_lineage.binding: Every future queue record, lease, fence, worker identity, attempt, idempotency key, reconciliation record, backup manifest, restore witness, abstraction receipt, and audit event binds the complete authenticated lineage. A future distributed transport may only preserve or narrow this lineage; it may never infer, replace, broaden, or repair it.
immutable_scope_lineage.tenant_database_identity: Each productive Tenant retains exactly one Tenant-bound Runtime database login and dedicated pool. A worker, failover, restore, or reused connection may never switch Tenant.

rules: A lease is bounded and is not authority.
Fence tokens are monotonic and every protected admission, dispatch, and effect boundary revalidates the current exact-scope token.
Lease expiry, clock uncertainty, lost heartbeat, storage ambiguity, partition, or stale generation stops the holder before a further protected mutation or effect.
A transfer is a separately auditable, compare-and-swap transition; a new owner never assumes that an old owner did not act.
A queue payload is untrusted transport data and may carry only opaque references; every trusted binding is re-resolved from authenticated Protected Control Plane context at each enforcement boundary.
Queue acknowledgement, lease acquisition, dispatch intent, and audit evidence are atomically correlated with the authoritative ledger or fail closed.
A duplicate delivery is not proof that an effect did not occur.
An ambiguous or non-idempotent effect becomes indeterminate; no blind retry or claim release is permitted before authoritative reconciliation.

reconciliation.ownership: A future reconciliation leader holds a bounded, fenced, scope-bound lease distinct from worker execution ownership.
rules: Only the authorized reconciler may resolve an indeterminate attempt into an evidence-backed terminal disposition through the owning Gate.
Reconciliation is idempotent, append-only, independently reviewable, and may not turn tool success into effect or goal success.
A concurrent or stale reconciler records no terminal resolution and must contain or defer.
A restored generation receives fresh worker generations and fence epoch; pre-restore workers and clusters cannot write after cutover.
Ready requires exact scope, protected-state, audit-chain, approval, claim, attempt, queue, lease, and reconciliation consistency evidence plus an independent witness.
Missing, contradictory, stale, or unverifiable restore evidence leaves the system contained and not-ready.

governed_cross_area_abstraction.permitted_only_after: an accepted explicit cross-Area ADR and contract with dual-scope authorization, minimum necessary versioned and redacted or aggregated abstraction, provenance, retention/deletion treatment, audit receipt, and independent review
prohibitions: cross-Area worker or pool identity reuse

non_regression_rules: Distribution may not weaken NB-5 serial Action Gate, sandbox, kill-switch, independent verifier, or indeterminate-effect controls.
Tool, executor, queue, worker, or transport success is never effect or goal success.
No policy, approval, recovery record, quorum, or human review overrides the Security Floor or creates missing authority.
Protected mutation and its audit evidence remain atomic; unavailable audit evidence denies or contains.
Distribution does not prove neural mechanism, cognitive quality, recognition, safety, production autonomy, or release readiness.

required_before_implementation: accepted current distributed ownership, queue, lease, failover, reconciliation, restore, and cross-Area ADR or contract
independent security, safety, database, and operations review
implementation_blocker.next_step: Do not implement runtime behavior. After every prerequisite is evidenced and accepted, split non-overlapping packages for schema and authorization, worker fencing, queue semantics, reconciliation, disaster recovery, cross-Area abstraction, and independent verification.
